# Brew21 Extra Chromosome Coffee Co.

> Family-run coffee bar at 209 W Commercial St, Springfield, Missouri 65803, started by the Justis family. Serves coffee and lemonade, sells merch, and offers a mobile coffee trailer for events. Open Wed–Sat, 8 AM–2 PM. Mission: great coffee and giving back to the special needs community.

## Pages
- [Home, shop, and Instagram](https://brew21.coffee/): story, hours, products, trailer booking
- [Online store](https://store.brew21.coffee/s/shop): whole bean and ground coffee, merch, lemonade (Square checkout)
- [Terms](https://brew21.coffee/terms/)
- [Privacy](https://brew21.coffee/privacy/)
